_about: Counts a correct reader must produce for export.current-shape.json. Worked out by hand and confirmed by two independent scripts. All content is invented.
shape: current (no children field, user and assistant messages only)

rules.message: A node of `mapping` whose `message` is an object. The root node (message null) is not a message.
rules.tree: Build the tree from each node's `parent`. Never read `children` (absent or empty in exports made since July 2026) and never read `metadata.parent_id` (in current exports it often names a node that is not in the file).
rules.current_path: Start at `current_node` and follow `parent` to the root. Everything else is off the current path (edits and regenerated answers).
rules.time_unit: `create_time` is Unix seconds, UTC. A number above 1e11 is milliseconds: divide it by 1000. Anything that is not a positive number counts as missing.
rules.effective_time: Use the message's own `create_time`. If it is missing, use the nearest ancestor that has one. If none has one, use the conversation's `create_time`.
rules.window: A message is inside the window when cutoff <= effective_time <= now + 86400. cutoff = now - 30 * 86400 seconds. The extra day absorbs clock and time-zone differences; later times count as outside.
rules.hidden_context: role `system`, or content_type `user_editable_context` / `model_editable_context` / `app_pairing_content`, or `metadata.is_visually_hidden_from_conversation` true. These are not prompts and not answers.
rules.answer: One generated reply. Group every `assistant` and `tool` node under the node you reach by walking up through parents until the parent is a `user` message or the root. Each group that holds at least one assistant message is one answer. Every node of the file is visited once, so branches are counted once each.
rules.answer_model: `metadata.model_slug` of the answer's visible text message (assistant, content_type text or multimodal_text, recipient absent or `all`); with several, the one with the latest effective time. If none has a slug: the latest assistant message of the group that has one. If none: the conversation's `default_model_slug`, unless it is null or `auto`. Otherwise `(unknown)`.
rules.answer_time: The effective time of the answer's first node.
rules.thinking_by_evidence: The answer's group holds a `thoughts` or `reasoning_recap` message, or a message with `metadata.reasoning_status` or `metadata.finished_duration_sec`.
rules.thinking_by_slug_only: No such evidence, but the model slug contains `thinking`, ends in `-t-mini` or `-pro`, or starts with `o` and a digit.
rules.thinking_seconds: Per `reasoning_recap` message: `metadata.finished_duration_sec` if present, else parse `content.content` (`Thought for 14s`, `Worked for 2m 9s`, `Thought for 12 seconds`, `a second` = 1, `a couple of seconds` = 2, `a few seconds` = 4). Add up hours, minutes and seconds.
rules.search: The answer's group holds a non-empty `metadata.search_result_groups` or `metadata.search_queries`, or a tool author name or assistant recipient that is `web`, starts with `web.` or is `browser`, or a `content_references` item with a ref of `ref_type` `search`. Citations alone (`grouped_webpages`, `sources_footnote`) are not proof of a search.
rules.attachments: Sum of the lengths of `metadata.attachments` on user prompts. Token size: `file_token_size`, or `fileSizeTokens` in old messages. Type: `mime_type`, or `mimeType` in old messages.
rules.empty_answer: An answer whose visible assistant text is empty after trimming.
rules.text_chars: JavaScript string length (UTF-16 units) of string parts plus `text` of audio_transcription parts, after removing the private-use citation markers: everything from U+E200 to the next U+E201, then any character left in U+E200..U+E20F.
rules.duplicates: When the same conversation id arrives twice (two exports dropped together), keep the one with the later `update_time`.

same_counts_required_for: this file with `"children": []` added to every node
this file loaded twice (every conversation is then a duplicate and is counted once)
